verdict.rationale: Helicone documents its own self-hosting options, including Docker Compose and other deployment methods (helicone-docs-14, helicone-docs-20, helicone-docs-55). Self-hosting lets a user decide where their logged data lives, but nothing in the evidence shows region or residency selection for the hosted cloud product. Missing for 10: hosted region selection (e.g., EU/US data residency), documentation of where cloud data is stored, and independent or hands-on corroboration of residency control.
